_about: Reviewed findings of tools/audit_integrity.py --check t12: how the tests, the verification code,
the examples and the support metadata changed between the baseline commit and the audited commit.
Each finding id is the audit's; verdict is justified or violation. evidence, quote and moved_to
are checked by the audit: text must be in the named file of the audited commit, in the baseline
commit's file (BASE:path) or in a commit message (a hash). A loosened, changed or removed
tolerance, and a removed tolerance check, needs the quoted reasoning. pre_work_failures lists the
tests that failed or errored in the recorded pre-work run; each must still exist, or its rename
must be recorded. tests/test_audit_integrity.py fails on an unreviewed finding or a stale entry.
pre_work_record: BASELINE_FAILURES.md and baseline_*.json of the workspace, recorded before the work at an earlier commit; not part of this repository.
